tools.name: happyfox_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets, newest activity first, with optional filters and HappyFox's search syntax. Paginated (page_info + data). Search `q` examples: `status:"New","In Progress"`, `priority:"High"`, `assignee:none`, `tag:"billing"`, `contact:"jane@example.com"`, `unresponded:true`, `breached:true`, `duedate:o

tools.name: happyfox_get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a ticket with its full conversation: status, priority, category, contact, assignee, custom fields, SLA breaches and every update (messages, private notes, property changes, attachment links that expire in 5 minutes). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers), paginated, or search them. Search `q` fields: name, email, phone (digits only, no +), updated_since, created_since — e.g. `name:adam email:adam@example.com` (space-separated, all must match). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/users/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact
tools.description: Fetch a contact by id or by email address — phones, contact groups, ticket counts and custom fields. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user/<id or email>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_groups
tools.description: List contact groups (typically customer companies) with their tagged email domains. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_groups/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact_group
tools.description: Fetch a contact group and its member contacts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_group/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_categories
tools.description: List ticket categories (queues) with their ids — needed to create a ticket or filter tickets. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/categories/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_staff
tools.description: List agents (staff) with their ids, roles, categories and active flag — the `staff` id every reply/note needs, and assignee ids. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/staff/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_statuses
tools.description: List ticket statuses with ids and behaviour (pending / completed) — ids used to change a ticket's status. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/statuses/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_priorities
tools.description: List ticket priorities with ids — ids used to set a ticket's priority. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/priorities/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields
tools.description: List ticket custom fields: id, type, choices (with choice ids), required flags and categories. Use the ids as t-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_custom_fields
tools.description: List contact custom fields: id, type, choices and required flag. Use the ids as c-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_reports
tools.description: List the saved reports (id, name, description) from the Reports module. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/reports/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_summary
tools.description: Summary counts for a saved report: ticket, completed, assigned, pending and unassigned counts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_tabular_data
tools.description: The tabular view of a saved report — one row per ticket (display_id, subject, status, assignee, due date), paginated. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/tabulardata/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_kb_articles
tools.description: Export the knowledge base: external (customer-facing) articles by default, or internal (agent-only) articles. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/kb/articles/ or /kb/internal-articles/.

tools.name: happyfox_create_ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket on behalf of a contact (created if the email is new). Needs a category id (a public category), a subject and a message in `text` or `html`. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

tools.name: happyfox_add_staff_reply
tools.description: Add an agent reply to a ticket and/or change its status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. The contact is emailed ONLY if update_customer is true (HappyFox default: false). With no message it just updates properties. Moving to a completed status may require the category's compulsory custom field

tools.name: happyfox_add_private_note
tools.description: Add an internal note (never sent to the contact), optionally alerting agents and changing status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_pvtnote/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_tags
tools.description: Add and/or remove tags on a ticket without touching anything else. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_tags/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_custom_fields
tools.description: Set ticket custom-field values (t-cf-<id>, ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields). HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. HappyFox treats this as create-or-edit keyed on email: if the email already exists that contact is updated, and any contact custom field NOT passed is reset — use happyfox_update_contact to edit an existing contact. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/users/.

tools.name: happyfox_update_contact
tools.description: Edit an existing contact's name, email or contact custom fields (c-cf-<id>). Phone numbers are edited via happyfox_create_contact with the phone id. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/user/<id>/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: happyfox_list_tickets, happyfox_get_ticket, happyfox_list_contacts, happyfox_get_contact, happyfox_list_contact_groups, happyfox_list_categories, happyfox_list_statuses, happyfox_list_priorities, happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields, happyfox_get_report_summary, happyfox_get_report_tabular_data, happyfox_create_ticket · Private data: happyfox_list_tickets, happyfox_get_ticket, happyfox_list_contacts, happyfox_get_contact, happyfox_list_contact_groups, happyfox_get_contact_group, happyfox_list_contact_custom_fields, happyfox_create_ticket, happyfox_add_staff_reply, happyfox_add_private_note, happyfox_create_contact, happyfox_update_contact · Public sink: happyfox_list_contacts, happyfox_get_contact, happyfox_list_contact_groups, happyfox_create_ticket, happyfox_add_staff_reply, happyfox_add_private_note, happyfox_update_ticket_tags, happyfox_update_ticket_custom_fields, happyfox_create_contact, happyfox_update_contact · Destructive: happyfox_update_ticket_tags, happyfox_create_contact.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
